description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the URL resolution of the /api/users endpoint within a client-side application. It includes methods to construct and log the expected API URL for debugging and validation purposes, especially during development.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs the expected URL for the /api/users endpoint with optional organization ID override, logs the URL, performs validation on query parameters during development, and restores previous state if needed.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A convenience helper that generates and logs a sample URL for a specific organization to verify URL resolution during development.
